One compliance run (ADR 0021): what the identity signs with portitor-dcp, the port (traits, dashed yellow) to the compliance service and its adapter, and where the result is kept

one is on, 404 with Gaia-X off

credential, then at two thirds of its
credential's id, gives back the answer as
The two credentials, VC 2.0, valid 90 days
carries them with the registration number
One run: reads the participant file, signs
checks the answer and its signature, stores
the four credentials. A failed run stores
gaiax_run, the last 100 runs are kept

C4 model, level 4. Solid arrows: uses. Dashed arrows: implements. The compliance service reads our DID document and, through x5u, the chain CertificateChain serves; GET /credentials/gaiax/{name} (serve_credential) serves the credentials sent.
